summary: An available discount goes unclaimed when nobody takes responsibility for the application.
realLife: At the Mojave Desert club’s 2016 headquarters opening, President Reyes asked someone to complete the paperwork for discounted internet service. Nobody volunteered (June 25, 2016).
inGame: needs: an available discount, its application and whether anyone accepted the task.

turns.what: The chair records the name and due date.
turns.pulledBy: A member takes the form before the application closes.
turns.writesBack: The application has an owner and can be tracked.

turns.what: The treasurer uses the ordinary service price in the office budget.
turns.pulledBy: The application period ends without an assigned member.
turns.writesBack: The discount never becomes an expected saving.
